name: FirstRun
what_it_does: Drop-in onboarding engine for web apps. Add one script tag and FirstRun reads the page, generates a three-step guided tour, and shows contextual tooltips the first time a user meets each feature. Tracks where new users drop off.
target_user: Small product teams and hackathon builders who ship a working app but have no time to design a first-run experience.
integrations: Any web app via script tag

agent_observations.note: FirstRun is the easiest product in the pool to understand (0.86) and its whole job is onboarding. It has no product of its own to onboard into, so it is most useful attached to another build.
